in_sanskrit.name: धन्जित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who conquers wealth or has victorious wealth

in_tamil.name: தங்களிட்சித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவர் அவர்களிடம் வெறு அல்லது வெறுங்களை அளித்தது - he has given wealth to others or has wealth within himself

in_marathi.name: Dhanjit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's wealth or treasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanjit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Dhan (wealth or treasure) and Jit (victory). The name signifies that the person who bears this name has been bestowed with God's wealth or treasure and has achieved victory over his enemies or challenges. In Hindu mythology, Dhanvantari, the God of Ayurveda and healer, is also known by this name.

In Hindu mythology, Dhanvantari, the God of Ayurveda and healer, is also known by this name.
